listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Your digestive system turns food into energy!
THE JOURNEY OF FOOD:
1. MOUTH
- Teeth chew food into small pieces
- Saliva starts breaking down starches
- Time: 30 seconds to 2 minutes
2. ESOPHAGUS
- A tube from mouth to stomach
- Muscles push food down (even upside down!)
- Time: 10 seconds
3. STOMACH
- Strong acids break down food
- Food becomes a thick liquid
- Time: 2-6 hours
4. SMALL INTESTINE
- Nutrients are absorbed into blood
- This is where most digestion happens
- Time: 4-5 hours
5. LARGE INTESTINE
- Water is absorbed
- Waste is stored
- Time: 10-24 hours
6. EXIT
- Waste leaves the body
TOTAL TIME: 24-72 hours for food to go through!
Remember: You need to eat healthy food to give your body good nutrients!
WEEKS 89-92: PHYSICS BASICS
Tuần 89-92: Vật lý Cơ bản
dictation: Your digestive system turns food into energy!

LARGE INTESTINE
- Water is absorbed
- Waste is stored
- Time: 10-24 hours
6.
